DU1.description: For learners with little or no schooling and limited literacy; not familiar with the Latin alphabet; slow pace and basic survival vocabulary.

DU2.description: For learners with 8-10 years of schooling; familiar with Latin letters and basic education; moderate pace.

modules.3: Can write short messages and describe events (A2)
modules.4: Can talk about experiences and opinions (A2+)
modules.5: Can handle work/social situations in Danish (B1)

DU3.description: For well-educated learners with strong grammar and academic background; understand English well; faster pace; may aim for university.

modules.2: Can handle basic written and spoken tasks (A2)
modules.4: Can discuss abstract themes, write essays (B1+)

word_selection_criteria: Appropriate to both DU level and module
Unique and not repeated from earlier modules unless foundational
Real Danish words in use today
No slang or outdated terms unless culturally essential
